drhp.business: Nephro Care India Limited is a healthcare provider specializing in nephrology and allied renal care, delivering dialysis services, nephrology consultations, chronic kidney disease (CKD) management, preventive healthcare and associated medical treatments through an integrated healthcare delivery model. Its services span in-patient (IPD) and out-patient (OPD) departments and an in-house pharmacy, with its subsidiary Vivacity Multi Speciality Hospital extending the group into kidney transplantation care.
drhp.expansion: Vivacity Multi Speciality Hospital (subsidiary) extended the group's capabilities beyond dialysis and nephrology into transplantation care, performing its first kidney transplant in November 2025. The Company's newer beds and capacity commissioned over the prior two years matured during FY 2025-26, driving higher IPD volumes. Management states it will deepen its presence across West Bengal and Eastern India and build on the early success of the transplant programme at Vivacity in FY 2026-27.

moat.body:
- brand: Founder-led clinical reputation with the Managing Director recognised as a leading nephrologist and credited with more than 1,000 kidney transplants — evidence: MD&CEO bio states over two decades of clinical expertise and 1,000+ kidney transplants to his credit.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:

- Changes in healthcare reimbursement models, patient preferences, technological advancements, and competitive dynamics may impact business performance.
- Availability and retention of qualified doctors, nephrologists, nurses, and healthcare professionals remain critical for sustained growth.
- Increasing dependence on digital healthcare systems exposes the Company to information security and cybersecurity risks.
- Macroeconomic conditions, inflationary pressures, and changes in healthcare spending patterns may affect operating performance.
- Healthcare services inherently involve clinical and operational risks that may impact patient outcomes and reputation.
